description: [$0.025] Were these tokens run by the same people? Give 2-4 mints and get the wallets appearing in more than one, each with the role it played in each. Weigh the roles rather than the count: shared holders are common, a wallet that was an insider in one and a sniper in the next is not. Mints outside our index come back named in not_covered.

mints.description: Two to four mints to compare.

says.description: The finding in one plain sentence, safe to quote.
